section_summary: This section continues a compiled directory of Japanese machine tool manufacturers, giving company histories, capitalization, products, plant locations and sources. It also contains brief cross-references for firms that merged or changed names. Page 151 begins a new group of companies capitalized between ¥1,000,000 and ¥5,000,000.

subfiles.title: Mitsubishi Kosaku Kikai K.K. — plants and sources
subfiles.about: Concludes a profile with three machine tool plants and source citations.
subfiles.summary: Lists plants in Hiroshima, Tokyo and Nagoya, then cites supporting reports.

subfiles.title: Mitsui Kosakuki K.K.
subfiles.about: Describes a Mitsui-linked machine tool concern established using American equipment and Norton licenses.
subfiles.summary: Gives its naming history, capitalization, products and Okegawa grinder plant.

subfiles.title: Nakajima Hikoki K.K.
subfiles.about: Identifies one Nakajima aircraft plant as a machine tool producer.
subfiles.summary: Lists capitalization, aircraft and precision-tool products, and a Gunma plant.

subfiles.title: Niigata Tekkosho
subfiles.about: Surveys Niigata Tekkosho's expansion, capitalization, broad machinery output and plants.
subfiles.summary: Describes a leading licensed machine tool firm that also made diesel engines, oil machinery and rolling stock. Eight plants are listed in Niigata, Tokyo and Saitama, followed by source references.

subfiles.title: Nippon Deizeru Kogyo
subfiles.about: Records a diesel engine and war-goods company's ownership, production and dispersed plants.
subfiles.summary: Lists plants in Korea, Kōriyama, Kawaguchi and Beijing, with a Kawaguchi diesel-engine production estimate.

subfiles.title: Nippon Denki Yakin Kogyo
subfiles.about: Lists the firm's capitalization, metal and machine-tool-part products, and five plant sites.
subfiles.summary: The profile identifies precision instruments, hard steel gauges, alloys and machine tool parts among its products; most plant products are unspecified.

subfiles.title: Nippon Rika Kogyo K.K.
subfiles.about: Notes the company's seven plants and welding, cutting and gas products.
subfiles.summary: A short profile gives founding year, capitalization, products and a source.

subfiles.title: Nippon Soda K.K.
subfiles.about: Notes that machine tool production cannot be assigned to particular plants.
subfiles.summary: Gives capitalization and a broad product list for a fourteen-plant company.

subfiles.title: Nippon Taipuraita
subfiles.about: Describes a typewriter and precision-machinery company and its plants.
subfiles.summary: Lists capitalization and products, with plant locations in Mukden and Tokyo.

subfiles.title: Nippon Tokushu Ko
subfiles.about: Records a special-steel firm with Sumitomo capital and some machine tool production.
subfiles.summary: Lists products and four plants in Tokyo, Aomori and Saitama.

subfiles.title: Nishimori Tekkojo — see Dai Nihon Koki K.K.
subfiles.about: Reports Nishimori Tekkojo's merger into Dai Nihon Koki.
subfiles.summary: Directs readers to Dai Nihon Koki K.K.

subfiles.title: Okamoto Kogyo K.K.
subfiles.about: Describes wartime expansion and one known machine tool plant.
subfiles.summary: Covers capitalization, ownership interests, war production and the Nagoya plant.

subfiles.title: Okuma Tekkosho K.K.
subfiles.about: Catalogues Okuma's capital growth, machine tool range and nine plants.
subfiles.summary: The profile describes investments in tooling machinery and a broad range of lathes, drills, grinders and other machines. Most listed plants are in Aichi, with one in Kokura.

subfiles.title: Osaka Denki
subfiles.about: Profiles a producer of cutting tools and electric welding machinery.
subfiles.summary: Gives capitalization, products and an Osaka plant estimated to make 1,500 welding machines monthly in 1940.

subfiles.title: Osaka Kikai Seisakusho
subfiles.about: Traces company acquisitions and lists its machine tools and nine plant sites.
subfiles.summary: Describes capitalization growth and products including boring, drilling, milling and planing machines. Plants are listed in Tokyo, Niigata, Shanghai, Nagoya, Osaka and Hyōgo.

subfiles.title: Osaka Kiko
subfiles.about: Describes a former textile-machinery firm's expansion into machine tools and munitions.
subfiles.summary: Records earlier company names, re-equipment of the Inagawa plant, capitalization and three plant sites.

subfiles.title: Osaka Seisha Zoki K.K.
subfiles.about: Describes a chain manufacturer's growth into a licensed machine tool company.
subfiles.summary: The profile discusses acquisition of Hirao Tekkosho and a possible connection to Mizogouchi Gear Works. It lists capitalization, gear-making and other machinery, eight plants and sources.

subfiles.title: Osaka Wakayama Tekkosho — see Dai Nihon Koki K.K.
subfiles.about: Reports Osaka Wakayama Tekkosho's merger into Dai Nihon Koki.
subfiles.summary: Directs readers to Dai Nihon Koki K.K.

subfiles.title: Rikagaku Kogyo
subfiles.about: Lists products and plants of a firm within the Riken industrial group.
subfiles.summary: Identifies four plant locations and products including lathes, piston rings and aircraft parts.

subfiles.title: Riken Jukogyo K.K.
subfiles.about: Identifies two machine tool plants among the firm's eleven plants.
subfiles.summary: Lists products and plants at Kumagaya and Maebashi.

subfiles.title: Riken Kogyo — see Riken Kosaku Kikai K.K.
subfiles.about: States that Riken Kogyo and Riken Kosaku Kikai are the same company.
subfiles.summary: Directs readers to Riken Kosaku Kikai K.K.

subfiles.title: Riken Kosaku Kikai
subfiles.about: Describes Baron Ōkōchi's manufacturing approach and the firm's machine tool production.
subfiles.summary: The profile criticizes the quality of its machine tools and testing machines, linking problems to reliance on less-skilled rural labor. It lists capitalization, products and two plant locations.

subfiles.title: Shibaura Kosaku Kikai
subfiles.about: Describes a Mitsui-linked machine tool subsidiary separated from Shibaura Seisakusho.
subfiles.summary: Lists capital, products and a Yokohama plant, including the subsidized Rotmill milling machine.

subfiles.title: Shibaura Seisakusho — see Shibaura Kosaku Kikai
subfiles.about: Records the 1939 separation of Shibaura Seisakusho's machine tool division.
subfiles.summary: Directs readers to Shibaura Kosaku Kikai.

subfiles.title: Shinagawa Seiki
subfiles.about: Describes the firm's expansion and proposed large-machine-tool factory.
subfiles.summary: Lists capitalization, turret lathes and other products, and five Tokyo and Kanagawa sites.

subfiles.title: Shinatsu Seisakusho
subfiles.about: Lists precision-tool and aircraft-related products and two plants.
subfiles.summary: Gives capitalization and sites in Nara and Kyoto.

subfiles.title: Shinohara Kikai Seisakusho — see Hitachi Seiki
subfiles.about: Reports Shinohara Kikai Seisakusho's merger with Hitachi Seiki.
subfiles.summary: Directs readers to Hitachi Seiki.

subfiles.title: Sumitomo Denki Kogyo K.K.
subfiles.about: Profiles two machine-tool-producing plants of an electrical manufacturer.
subfiles.summary: Lists capitalization, hard-alloy tools and electrical products, and Osaka and Itami plants.

subfiles.title: Sumitomo Kinzoku Kogyo
subfiles.about: Records capital expansion and one machine tool plant in Manchuria.
subfiles.summary: Lists grinders and rolling stock equipment as products.

subfiles.title: Tanaka Kikai Seisakusho
subfiles.about: Describes a firm with Mitsubishi, Mitsui and Sumitomo capital and four plants.
subfiles.summary: Lists capital, lathes, presses, cranes, milling machines and sites in Osaka, Tokyo, Yokohama and Kawaguchi.

subfiles.title: Toa Kinzoku Kogyo
subfiles.about: Describes expansion of a light-metal casting plant and the proposed appointment of a president.
subfiles.summary: Gives capitalization, products and three plants in Hyōgo Prefecture.

subfiles.title: Tokyo Gasu Denki — see Tokyo Kiki Kogyo K.K.
subfiles.about: Reports Tokyo Gasu Denki's merger with Tokyo Kiki Kogyo.
subfiles.summary: Directs readers to Tokyo Kiki Kogyo K.K.

subfiles.title: Tokyo Kikai Seisakusho
subfiles.about: Describes a subsidized machine tool manufacturer's expansion and government and aircraft-industry orders.
subfiles.summary: Lists capitalization, lathes and gear cutters, five Tokyo-area plants and sources. The profile says the firm was one of six government-subsidized companies producing machine tools exclusively.

subfiles.title: Tokyo Kiki Kogyo K.K.
subfiles.about: Describes a Hitachi machine tool subsidiary formerly associated with Tokyo Gasu Denki.
subfiles.summary: Lists capital, milling machines and other precision tools, plus four Tokyo and Kanagawa locations.

subfiles.title: Toyo Kikai K.K. — see Mitsubishi Kosaku Kikai
subfiles.about: Reports Toyo Kikai's merger with Mitsubishi Kosaku Kikai.
subfiles.summary: Directs readers to Mitsubishi Kosaku Kikai.

subfiles.title: Toyo Kogyo Kaisha
subfiles.about: Profiles a vehicle and machine tool producer backed by Mitsubishi and Sumitomo.
subfiles.summary: Lists capitalization, grinders, milling machines, lathes and a Hiroshima-area plant.

subfiles.title: Toyo Kohan — see Mitsubishi Kosaku Kikai
subfiles.about: Reports Toyo Kohan's merger with Mitsubishi Kosaku Kikai.
subfiles.summary: Directs readers to Mitsubishi Kosaku Kikai.

subfiles.title: Toyo Seiki K.K.
subfiles.about: Describes a Mitsui-dominated precision machine tool manufacturer formerly called Tsugami Seisakusho.
subfiles.summary: Records American machine tool orders, capitalization, products and a Tokyo location.

subfiles.title: Toyoda Boshoku
subfiles.about: Lists machine tools, aircraft parts and ordnance production at three plants.
subfiles.summary: Gives founding date, capitalization and sites in Aichi and Osaka.

subfiles.title: Toyoda Koki
subfiles.about: Describes a former Toyoda Jidosha machine tool unit and its expansion plans.
subfiles.summary: Gives differing capital reports, ownership, lathes and a Kariya plant.

subfiles.title: Toyoda Shiki
subfiles.about: Records a Nagoya producer of large lathes and vertical milling machines.
subfiles.summary: Gives founding year, capitalization and plant location.

subfiles.title: Toyoda Shiki Orihata — see Toyowa Kosakuki K.K.
subfiles.about: Explains mergers and separation leading to Toyowa Kosakuki.
subfiles.summary: Directs readers from Toyoda Shiki Orihata to Toyowa Kosakuki K.K.

subfiles.title: Toyokuni Kikai Kogyo K.K.
subfiles.about: Profiles a Mitsubishi-assisted machine tool and ordnance firm.
subfiles.summary: Gives capitalization, products and a Nagoya plant.

subfiles.title: Toyowa Jukogyo — see Toyowa Kosakuki K.K.
subfiles.about: Records the separation of Toyowa Jukogyo's machine tool department.
subfiles.summary: Directs readers to its Toyowa Kosakuki subsidiary.

subfiles.title: Toyowa Kosakuki K.K.
subfiles.about: Describes a Toyowa Jukogyo subsidiary expanding machine tool production.
subfiles.summary: Lists capitalization, grinding and cutting machines, aircraft parts and its Shinkawa plant.

subfiles.title: Tsugami Ataka Seisakusho
subfiles.about: Profiles a leading maker of precision machine tools and surveying instruments.
subfiles.summary: Gives ownership, capitalization, products and plants in Niigata and Nagano.

subfiles.title: Companies with capitalization between ¥1,000,000 and ¥5,000,000
subfiles.about: Introduces the next capitalization group in the directory.
subfiles.summary: Section heading for smaller-capitalized companies.

subfiles.title: Abe Tekkosho K.K.
subfiles.about: Profiles an Osaka producer of planing machines.
subfiles.summary: Gives capitalization, product and plant location.

subfiles.title: Akasaka Tekkosho
subfiles.about: Describes a diesel-engine manufacturer that began making lathes.
subfiles.summary: Gives capital, products and a Yaizu plant.

subfiles.title: Akimoku Kikai Seisakusho
subfiles.about: Describes a sawmill-machinery firm that expanded into steel and machine tool parts.
subfiles.summary: Lists capitalization, bearings, machine-tool beds and plants in Akita and Osaka; one plant's location is unknown.

subfiles.title: Asahi Seiki K.K.
subfiles.about: Lists precision machinery and aircraft-related output at Tokyo and Gunma sites.
subfiles.summary: Gives founding year, capitalization, products and plants.

subfiles.title: Daido Kikai Seisakusho
subfiles.about: Profiles a Daido Seiko subsidiary making lathes and metal welders.
subfiles.summary: Gives capitalization and a Nagoya plant.

subfiles.title: Daini Kokusan Denki K.K.
subfiles.about: Profiles a maker of electrical parts and polishing machines.
subfiles.summary: Gives capitalization, products and a Tokyo plant.

subfiles.title: Enshu Kikai
subfiles.about: Describes a former loom manufacturer that shifted to military production and milling machines.
subfiles.summary: Gives capitalization, products, plant relocation and production estimates.

subfiles.title: Fuhsin Seisakusho
subfiles.about: Profiles a Manchurian maker of machine tools and mining machinery.
subfiles.summary: Gives capitalization, products and a Fuxin plant.
